channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Walk (330 Berry St)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Walk (330 Berry St) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The City's Enterprise Addressing System has an address point for 330 Berry St (address ID 702079) inside this record's outline. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/3mea-di5p.json?eas_address_id=702079.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): In October 2008 SocketSite reported that applications…
item.description: In October 2008 SocketSite reported that applications were open for the 131 below-market-rate condos that "will compose Mission Walk (330/335 Berry Street)", with a lottery set for January 28, 2009. The post says the site "might still be wrapped in scaffolding" and does not say how far construction had gone. Source: https://socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The shape's note now names the mapping log in words…
item.description: The shape's note now names the mapping log in words instead of printing a web address. No change to the shape, status or use. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The summary for Mission Walk (330 Berry St) now includes…
item.description: The summary for Mission Walk (330 Berry St) now includes 2009-10 completion reports. Source: https://socketsite.com/archives/2010/03/relaxing_bmr_rules_at_mission_walk_to_compete_with_bank.html.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The Mission Walk pages now say that SocketSite reported…
item.description: The Mission Walk pages now say that SocketSite reported 131 below-market condos at 330 and 335 Berry St in 2008, while a condo listing site counts 41 and 39 units in the two buildings (80 in all); the sources are not reconciled. Source: SocketSite, 2008-10-27 (socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html); San Francisco Condo Market, 330 and 335 Berry St (sanfranciscocondomarket.com/building/330-berry-st, /335-berry-st); Mayor's Office of Housing / OCII memo, 2023-10-20.

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The Mission Walk (330 Berry St) page now says the unit…
item.description: The Mission Walk (330 Berry St) page now says the unit count is unsettled: a listing site gives 41 units, the Assessor's 2025 roll has 64 condominium lots at 330 Berry, and SocketSite (October 2008) reported 131 below-market-rate condos for 330 and 335 Berry together. Year built, 2009, is the Assessor roll's value. Source: sanfranciscocondomarket.com/building/330-berry-st; DataSF Assessor wv5m-vpq2, block 8704; SocketSite, 2008-10-27 (socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html).

item.title: Correction · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): The summary said the condos were built under the…
item.description: The summary said the condos were built under the Redevelopment Agency's Affordable Homeownership Program and allocated by a January 2009 lottery; the SocketSite post only announces 131 BMR condos and a scheduled lottery, so the summary now says that. The map shape's sourcing now states that about two thirds of the shape is an extension added in this project's own mapping rather than a real building footprint, and the out-of-date 'opening year and unit count not confirmed' note now cites 2009 and 41 units from the record's own sources. The NAIP photo credit now names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center. Source: SocketSite, 2008-10-27 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2008/10/mission_walk_330335_berry_applications_now_available_du.html); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 330 Berry St (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8704&lot=278); San Francisco Condo Market, 330 Berry St (https://www.sanfranciscocondomarket.com/building/330-berry-st); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery).

item.title: Planned · Mission Walk (330 Berry St): Below-market-rate purchase applications open for… (Oct 2008)
item.description: Below-market-rate purchase applications open for the 131 condos that "will compose Mission Walk (330/335 Berry Street)", with a lottery set for January 28, 2009.
